from common.config import get_cfg from connectors.csap.connector import CsapConnector csap_client = CsapConnector( access_id="2439cd9f-43ed-42cb-93b3-f458893b7f9e", secret_key="cbb358dd-1b7e-4637-a5be-cc8a8d27bb08", base_url="https://cybank.cyware.com/api/tenant/", email="devansh.handa@cyware.com", ) _payload = { "card_type_name": "Malware Advisories", "category_name": "Malware and Vulnerabilities", "lead_url": "https://securityboulevard.com/2026/03/sonatype-discovers-two-malicious-npm-packages/", "cyware_tags": [ "Vulnerability", "Breach/Incident" ], "card_tag": [ "Sonatype", "npm", "sbx-mask", "touch-adv", "Sonatype Security Research" ], "target_geog_names": [ "Global" ], "target_sector_names": [ "Information Technology" ], "consumer_push": False, "enterprise_push": True, "title": "Sonatype Identifies Malicious npm Packages \"sbx-mask\" and \"touch-adv\" Exfiltrating Secrets", "card_more_info": None, "consumer_source_name": "threatpost", "content": " Key Highlights
\nSonatype Security Research has identified a compromise involving two malicious npm packages, \"sbx-mask\" and \"touch-adv,\" which are designed to exfiltrate sensitive information from victims' computers. These packages were published through a compromised trusted npm maintainer account, posing a significant threat to developers and organizations relying on npm for package management.

\n\n Recent Activity
\n• The malicious packages were recently discovered and are believed to have been distributed through npm, a widely used package manager for JavaScript.
\n• The compromise of the maintainer account suggests a targeted attack aimed at injecting malicious code into the npm ecosystem.

\n\n Spread and Exploitation
\n• The packages \"sbx-mask\" and \"touch-adv\" are designed to exfiltrate secrets from infected systems.
\n• They exploit the trust in npm packages to infiltrate systems and extract sensitive data, potentially leading to unauthorized access and data breaches.

\n\n Malware Behavior
\n• Once installed, these malicious packages can access and exfiltrate sensitive information from the victim's computer.
\n• The exact methods of exfiltration and the types of data targeted are not detailed, but the potential for significant data loss and unauthorized access is high.

\n\n Recommended Actions
\n
    \n
  • Immediately audit npm packages for the presence of \"sbx-mask\" and \"touch-adv\" and remove them if found.
    • \n
  • Monitor systems for unusual activity that may indicate data exfiltration.
    • \n
  • Implement strict access controls and regularly review npm package dependencies for unauthorized changes.
    • \n
  • Educate developers on the risks of using third-party packages and encourage the use of verified sources.
    • \n
  • Consider using tools that can detect and block malicious npm packages before they are installed.
    • \n
